text: dsh-harness-panel 是面向 DSH Web 设置页的 Harness 管理面板，在导航中加入 MCP、Skills、Hooks 和 AGENTS.md 四个页面。它读取 MCP 服务器状态并提供连通性探测与启停入口，展示当前会话的 Skills 并可切换启用状态，解析 Hook 配置并按命令切换，还能查看指令文件加载链并编辑候选 AGENTS.md 文件。适合需要在一个设置区域检查 Harness 配置和管理这些集成的用户；安装需将插件加入 profile bundle 并重启 DSH。

dsh-harness-panel adds MCP, Skills, Hooks, and AGENTS.md pages to DSH Web Settings. It shows MCP status and probes, lists and toggles session Skills, displays Hook commands, and previews and edits candidate AGENTS.md files. Install it in a profile bundle and restart DSH.
想在 DSH 设置里查看 MCP 服务器状态并测试连接。
如何在设置页面启用或停用当前会话的 Skill？
I want one place in DSH Settings to inspect hook configs and the AGENTS.md instruction files loaded for my session.
dsh-harness-panel 的功能「MCP 服务器面板」：查看已配置服务器的状态、传输方式和工具清单，并可发起一次连接探测或通过设置页开关控制服务器行。
dsh-harness-panel 的功能「Skills、Hooks 与指令文件管理」：按当前会话列出 Skills，可切换 Skill 和 Hook 命令；同时展示 AGENTS.md 加载候选及状态，并提供文件编辑入口。
dsh-harness-panel 使用「探测」时会向所配置的 HTTP MCP 服务发送 initialize 请求，并附带该服务器配置的请求头；探测也可对 stdio 服务执行握手。

dsh-harness-panel README · dsh-harness-panel：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that adds a **Harness** page to Settings — one place to inspect and start/stop MCP servers, enable/disable skills, start/stop hook bridges, and inspect or edit the AGENTS.md instruction chain, styled to match the native settings UI.

English · [中文](#中文)

dsh-harness-panel README · Features：- Every configured `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` row: an available/unavailable badge (green/red) — observed status when the upstream `mcp/status` seam reports one, otherwise inferred from the live row and its registered tools — transport, sanitized target, tool inventory
- A native start/stop switch on every addressable row, through the same `pluginManager` Remote the built-in Plugins page uses; disabling stops the mcp-client row and its tools
- One-shot connectivity probe per server (streamable-http `initialize` POST / stdio spawn handshake, 10s deadline)
- Env/header values never leave the host (keys only, URLs credential-redacted)

dsh-harness-panel README · Features：- The current session's user-invocable skill catalog — the same seam the composer `/` menu reads (`remote.skills`), so the panel always agrees with the composer
- A native enable/disable switch per skill. Disabling sets the provider's own frontmatter keys (`user-invocable: false`, `disable-model-invocation: true`) in the skill's SKILL.md, so it leaves the model catalog and the `/` menu in every registry scope; the panel keeps listing it with an off switch, and re-enabling restores the original frontmatter lines
- Search filter, model-invocable badge, source path

dsh-harness-panel README · Features：- Mounted hook bridges (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code` / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-codex`): each row's `configPath` file parsed into event → matcher → command views
- A per-command switch inside each expanded group: turning one hook off flips its `type` to the sentinel the bridges skip, records the original value, and reloads the bridge row so it takes effect immediately. The bridge row itself deliberately carries no whole-row switch — the loader's live re-enable of a row is unreliable, so the page stays at the granularity the file edit serves
- Conventional on-disk locations (`~/.claude/settings.json`, `~/.codex/hooks.json`, project-level, …) scanned read-only and clearly marked **not mounted**

dsh-harness-panel README · Features：- The workspace-instruction chain the current session loads, in the loader's own order: `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md`, `$DSH_AGENTS_HOME/AGENTS.md`, then the project root down to the session working directory, base candidates before each directory's `.local` overlays
- Every candidate's disposition: loaded, empty, truncated, omitted by the byte budget, duplicate within its candidate group, over the per-source cap, unreadable, or missing. The same budget algorithm the loader uses decides statuses and produces an exact **content that will be injected** preview
- The active agent preset is resolved through the session projection, the preset's `plugins` list, and the root fallback, so the displayed `maxBytes`/candidate configuration is the one in effect
- An inline editor per file, backed by a host write route with an allowlisted candidate path, a 1 MiB content cap, and an mtime precondition; saving through `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md -> ~/.agents/AGENTS.md` preserves the symlink. Missing candidates can be created from their directory card

dsh-harness-panel README · Design：The visual language follows the shipped settings sections rather than inventing its own: `--dsw-*` design tokens only (no hard-coded colors), native corner radii (`--dsw-radius-xl` cards, `--dsw-radius-md` controls), 0.5px hairline strokes, the underline tab strip used by the built-in Plugins page, and the shipped `Switch` atom from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` — the exact control the Plugins page uses. Light and dark themes both work.

dsh-harness-panel README · Install：Desktop profile (`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`):

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
dsh-harness-panel README · package.json → dsh.profile.bundles: add "dsh-harness-panel"：pnpm install

dsh-harness-panel README · restart DSH (the desktop profile has no live reload)：```

Or install by local path from Settings → Plugins.

dsh-harness-panel README · Security boundary：- MCP and hook bridge switches call the shipped `remote.pluginManager.setPluginEnabled`: the official manager writes the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` and reloads the row, exactly as the built-in Plugins page does. This host half registers no write route for them
- The host half's write routes are `POST /harness-panel/skills/toggle`, `POST /harness-panel/hooks/toggle-hook`, and `POST /harness-panel/agents/write`. Each requires `content-type: application/json`, an `x-harness-panel: 1` header, and a same-origin `Origin` when the browser sends one; the toggle bodies are bounded to 16 KiB and the AGENTS.md body to 4 MiB
- A skill toggle edits only the two invocation keys of the named skill's own SKILL.md (verified against the file's declared name); a hook toggle edits only that command's `type`; an AGENTS.md write is refused unless the path is a candidate discovered for the requested working directory, and its `expectedMtimeMs` must match the file on disk. Symlinked candidates are written through so the link survives, but a resolved target outside the project root or either instruction home is refused
- The host writes only those file edits p

dsh-harness-panel README · Development：```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build       # emits lib/index.js (host ESM) + lib/client.js (browser bundle)
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test        # vitest: mcp aggregation, hooks parsing, AGENTS.md discovery/render/file edits, sanitization, skill file/state, route gates, switch models

dsh-harness-panel README · Development：The scripts prefer `bunx` and fall back to the local Node. On the macOS desktop install the DSH-bundled Node is hardened and cannot load the ad-hoc native rollup/rolldown bindings, so `bunx tsdown` / `bunx vitest run` is the path that works there.

dsh-harness-panel README · Development：Compatibility: DSH `>=0.2.0 <0.3.0` (developed against desktop 0.2.1-rc.1). AGENTS.md discovery, dedupe and budget rendering mirror `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions` 0.2.1-rc.2; if a later loader changes those semantics, the panel needs the same adjustment.

dsh-harness-panel README · 中文：DeepSeek Harness 设置面板插件：在设置导航中新增 **Harness** 入口，集中查看并启停 MCP 服务器、Skills 与 Hooks，并查看/编辑 AGENTS.md 指令链，视觉与原生设置页一致。

dsh-harness-panel README · 中文：- **MCP**：已配置服务器的状态徽章显示「可用 / 不可用」（绿 / 红）——收到上游 `mcp/status` 事件时按事件状态显示，无事件时按该行是否已激活及已注册工具推断；同时展示传输方式、脱敏目标、工具清单，一键探活；每个可寻址行右侧有原生启停开关，停用后 mcp-client 行与其工具一起下线
- **Skills**：当前会话可见的 skill 目录（与 `/` 菜单同源），每个 skill 右侧有原生启用/停用开关。停用直接写入该 skill SKILL.md 的官方 frontmatter 键（`user-invocable: false`、`disable-model-invocation: true`），在任何 registry scope 都生效，skill 从模型目录与 `/` 菜单消失；面板仍以关闭状态列出，重新启用时按记录还原原始行
- **Hooks**：已挂载的 hook 桥配置解析（事件点 → 匹配器 → 命令），展开后**每条 command 有独立开关**——关闭时把该 hook 的 `type` 改为 bridge 跳过的哨兵值（provider 自身的机制），记录原始值并重载 bridge 行立即生效。bridge 整行不设总开关：loader 对整行的热恢复不可靠，面板停留在文件编辑能服务的粒度。本机约定路径上**未挂载**的配置文件继续只读扫描
- **AGENTS.md**：按 loader 的真实顺序展示当前会话的指令链（`$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md` → `$DSH_AGENTS_HOME/AGENTS.md` → 项目根到会话工作目录，每层先基础候选再 `.local` 覆盖），标注每个候选的最终去向：已注入、空文件、被截断、因预算省略、同组重复折叠、超过单文件上限、不可读或未创建。预算与去重按 `dsh-agent-instructions` 0.2.x 的算法复刻，并给出**将注入内容**的完整预览；当前 preset 通过会话投影与 preset `plugins` 解析，显示实际生效的 `maxBytes` 与候选配置。每个文件有内联编辑器，保存走候选路径白名单 + 1 MiB 内容上限 + mtime 前置校验；`~/.dsh/AGENTS.md -> ~/.agents/AGENTS.md` 这类符号链接写穿目标而保留链接，缺失候选可在对应目录卡片中新建

dsh-harness-panel README · 中文：安全边界：MCP 与 hook 开关调用 shipped `remote.pluginManager.setPluginEnabled`，由官方 manager 写 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 并 reload，与内置 Plugins 页一致；host 的写入路由为 `POST /harness-panel/skills/toggle`、`POST /harness-panel/hooks/toggle-hook` 与 `POST /harness-panel/agents/write`，均要求 JSON、`x-harness-panel: 1` 与同源 `Origin`，开关类 body 上限 16 KiB，AGENTS.md 写入上限 4 MiB。skill 开关只改目标 SKILL.md 的两个 invocation 键（先校验声明的 skill name），hook 开关只改该命令的 `type`；AGENTS.md 写入只接受本次按请求工作目录发现出的候选路径，且 `expectedMtimeMs` 必须与磁盘一致；符号链接写穿目标，但目标落在项目根或两个指令 home 之外时拒绝写入。host 写出的文件仅这些编辑与 `$DSH_HOME/harness-panel/state.json`（默认 `~/.dsh/harness-panel/state.json`，0600），state 文件只含 skill 名称、描述、路径、停用时间与原始行记录，不含正文与凭据。AGENTS.md 发现与读取使用 host 的 Node 文件系统而非 agent 沙箱 provider；文件内容只返回给同源面板，不写日志。路由仅监听 loopback。
